Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionUnleash pure chaos as a furious rabbit in this fast-paced comedic brawler with roguelike elements! Fight through waves of quirky enemies, unlock absurd upgrades, and experiment with wild abilities that change every run. Smash, spin, and explode your way through vibrant, comic-style arenas where every battle is unpredictable, over-the-top, and packed with humor. Key features: - Chaotic Beat’em Up Combat: Dive into fast-paced, over-the-top battles where every hit is packed with comic-style effects and exaggerated action. - Roguelike Progression: Each run is different - choose between random upgrades, stack crazy abilities, and create unique builds every time you play. - Absurd Weapons & Skills: Use ridiculous abilities like spinning ear attacks, explosive carrots, and powerful charge strikes to wipe out enemies in style. - Dynamic Enemy Waves: Face growing hordes of enemies that become faster and stronger, forcing you to adapt and survive as long as possible. - Vibrant Comic World: Fight across colorful, stylized arenas that feel like living comic panels, filled with humor, chaos, and visual punch. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraftReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - MinecraftFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends.CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play!VIBRANT VISUALS* Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER** Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS* - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE NINTENDO SWITCH™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. **Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account.
